name: rowan
description: Hover over a variable to see the keys / values rowan infers for it; missing-key verdicts as diagnostics.

rowan.binaryPath.description: Path to the rowan binary. Empty: look for rowan/target/release/rowan under a workspace folder, under any ancestor of the analysed file, or next to the extension; then ~/.cargo/bin/rowan; then `rowan` on PATH.

rowan.analyseOnSave.description: Re-analyse a Python file whenever it is saved (and when it is opened).

rowan.timeoutSeconds.description: Give up on an analysis after this many seconds.
